title: Cerebus the Aardvark #134 1990 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics Dave Sim Jaka's Story 21
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book titled "Cerebus the Aardvark #134" published in 1990 by Aardvark-Vanaheim. The comic book features the story of Jaka's Story, Part 21 and has art and writing by Dave Sim and Gerhard. It is a softcover comic book intended for a general audience and is a part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) of US Comics.

The comic book is in English language and has a dust jacket and is boarded for added protection. It belongs to the genres of adventure, animal, fantasy, and fiction and is a great addition to any comic book collection. Get your hands on this unique comic book today!
